name: H3 Prompt Guide Challenge — Part 1
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: An exploratory presentation of 100 A/B pairs / 200 AI-generated clips, using one matched seed, Hyperflow 8-step, 960 × 544, and MotionCache off. This is not a definitive validation or refutation of the prompting guide. Audio-semantic judgments and cross-seed replication remain pending.
The presentation is self-contained and uses no inference server or GPU. Configuration follows the official static-Space documentation and appfile configuration reference.
evidence comparisons and clear distinctions between observations and unknowns.
